items.title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
items.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Fable 5.1, a generally available model it describes as its most capable yet for coding and knowledge work, alongside Claude Mythos 5.1, a variant with fewer built-in safeguards offered only to vetted cybersecurity and life-sciences organizations under a restricted-access program. Anthropic also cut cache-read pricing by roughly 75%, and published a joint system card for the two models. Both are the same underlying model, differing only in which safeguards are applied.

Recommend re-verifying directly on anthropic.com if network access is restored.

items.title: Anthropic introduces Enterprise Frontier Safeguards for business customers
items.summary_en: Anthropic announced Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), a new offering that stores Claude activity-monitoring data in cloud infrastructure controlled by the customer rather than by Anthropic, while Anthropic's automated systems still perform misuse detection. Anthropic says the design was developed with more than 100 enterprise customers across sectors including financial services, healthcare and the public sector, in cooperation with AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure, and that it will roll out in phases starting later in autumn 2026 at no extra cost. Anthropic states human review by its own employees is not part of this workflow.

items.title: Claude Cowork adds a built-in browser to the desktop app
items.summary_en: Anthropic's Claude team announced that the Claude desktop app (Mac, Windows, Linux) now includes a built-in, sandboxed Chromium-based browser inside Cowork, letting Claude open a side-panel browser to navigate sites, read pages, and fill in forms without requiring the user's own browser or an extension. The feature launched live on Enterprise plans with a rollout to Pro, Max and Team users over the following week, and includes site-by-site cookie import so sensitive logins (banking, email, single sign-on) stay excluded by default.

items.title: Claude for Teachers expands to US school districts; Detroit pilot announced
items.summary_en: Anthropic expanded Claude for Teachers, previously available to individually verified educators, into a free, centrally managed Enterprise offering for US K-12 schools and districts, with a FERPA-aligned data processing agreement and a commitment that classroom data is not used for model training. As part of this expansion, Anthropic said it will pilot an evaluation of Claude for Teachers in the Detroit Public Schools Community District, training teachers at a handful of schools and studying effects on educator workload and teaching practice.
